# Generate standardized error message (deprecated)

<small>Source: [`R/messages.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/messages.R) · Help: `?std_error`</small>

Deprecated since 0.14.0: an internal helper of the package, which leaves the
exports in 1.0.0. It still works and warns.

## Usage

```r
std_error(type, ...)
```

## Arguments

`type`
:   Error message type.

`...`
:   Named arguments to replace in the template.

## Value

Stops execution with a formatted message.
